title: Integral Perverse Obstructions for Normal Surface Singularities: Resolution Determinants and Monodromy
summary: For a germ $(X,0)$ of a normal complex analytic surface, let $E:=H^0({}^p_+IC_X\mathbb Z)_0$, where ${}^pIC_X\mathbb Z$ and ${}^p_+IC_X\mathbb Z$ denote the ordinary and dual middle-perversity intersection complexes with integral coefficients. This finite abelian group measures the integral discrepancy between the two middle extensions. Motivated by work of Jung--Saito, we study $E$ as a local invariant of the singularity. We prove that $E$ admits a topological realization as $H^2(L,\mathbb Z)_{\tors}$, where $L$ is the link of the singularity, and a geometric realization as the discriminant…
